<div class="card-body">
'''Tentacle''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Immediate Effect]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">触手</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手がインタラプトを使用した直後に、1フォースを使用して場に配備する。そのインタラプトは通常通りの効果を及ぼすが、その後で触手に“巻きつかれる”（その場に置かれ、ゲームからは除外される）。同じ名前のインタラプトは今後すべて単一（＊）カードとなる。このエフェクトは「コントロール」の影響を受けない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Tentacle-SWCA-67795.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ダイアノーガは7本の触手を使って獲物を探し、捕える。幸運にもこの攻撃を生き延びた者たちによれば、この触手は水圧クランプなみの怪力を持っているという。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tentacle.

'''Card text:'''
Just after the opponent plays an Interrupt, use 1 Force to deploy on table. That Interrupt still has its usual effect, then is entwined by the tentacle. It is placed here and removed from the game. All Interrupts of the same name become unique cards. This Effect is not affected by Control.

'''Lore:'''
A dianoga uses its seven tentacles to find and catch prey. Survivors of such attacks say a tentacle has the monstrous strength of a hydro-clamp.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 即効エフェクト.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tentacle]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
